items.title: Netflix says it's already used AI in 'roughly 300' titles this year
items.excerpt: Netflix disclosed in its Q2 shareholder letter that generative-AI workflows were used in roughly 300 titles released or produced in 2026, concentrated in post-production (enhanced crowds, historical battle sequences, establishing shots). It named Glory (India), Brasil 70: A Saga do Tri and The American Experiment as examples, arguing the tools deliver higher-quality output faster and cheaper while human expertise stays essential.

items.title: Meet Martini: A Film Set for AI Video That Aims to Help Filmmakers Streamline Their Shots
items.excerpt: Martini is a collaborative web-based platform pitched as a 'film set' for AI video production, giving filmmakers real cinematic controls and shot composition in 2D or 3D environments instead of trial-and-error prompt generation. It doubles as a pre-production hub where crews can plan and block shots together in real time, with a free indie tier and paid plans from $15/month.

items.title: Elon Musk claims Grok will make a 'historically accurate' Odyssey by the end of the year
items.excerpt: Elon Musk says xAI's Grok Imagine will generate a full-length, 'historically accurate' film adaptation of Homer's Odyssey by year's end, framing generative text-to-video as a rival to Christopher Nolan's theatrical version. The sample footage shown so far has significant quality issues, making the claim a test of how far AI feature generation can actually go.

items.title: How Serviceplan MAKE Uses Luma to Put Creativity First
items.excerpt: Case study: agency Serviceplan MAKE uses Luma's generative video to visualize concepts and deliver client-ready shots in a single day instead of multi-day studio production. The workflow shift moves time away from execution/post toward concept refinement and faster client feedback.

items.title: Meshy Wants AI to Feel Less Like a Prompt and More Like a Creative Partner
items.excerpt: Meshy launched its 3D Agent Beta, a conversational AI that acts as a creative collaborator rather than a one-shot prompt tool, holding context across a session so artists can set a consistent art direction and generate stylistically unified families of 3D assets. It positions AI for early-stage concept exploration for film/VFX and animation pipelines while keeping artistic control with the creator.

items.title: Autodesk Adds AI and 3DGS Tools Across Maya, 3ds Max and More at SIGGRAPH 2026
items.excerpt: At SIGGRAPH 2026 Autodesk unveiled AI and 3D Gaussian Splats updates across its creative suite: MotionMaker in Maya gains 'Bring Your Own Data' so teams can train custom generative motion models on their own rigs and animation datasets, 3ds Max adds fully editable 3DGS with native Arnold rendering, and Flow Production Tracking adds real-time collaborative review. The tools target repetitive animation, real-world object recreation and iterative lighting.
